title: Linked calendar shows up on startup but disappears during sync ...
creator: flashfletch
content: Using Win 10 and Thunderbird Meadow 153.8.0esr (32-bit). I have been using Thunderbird/Lightning for MANY years and have had a linked calendar from another website syncing happily for most of that time. Following a recent update of Thunderbird, this linked calendar has become quite problematic. On startup, the linked calendar entries show up on my month display and in the events sidebar, but the linked calendar shows as ENABLE. When I do this, the calendar flashes up momentarily and then goes away, no matter how many times I try to enable it. I have tried to create a new link to the calendar using the link generated by the website, but Thunderbird says it can't find any calendars at that link. It can obviously see the linked calendar at startup, but will not keep the calendar open after that. HELP!!!!!!!!!!! flashfletch Before and after screenshots attached

title: One of my two email accounts suddenly stopped receiving emails despite having worked normally before, while the other account continues to receive emails without any issues.
creator: k-katsuyama
content: I have two email accounts configured in Thunderbird, both of which had been receiving emails normally until one of them suddenly stopped receiving messages, and despite the other account continuing to work as expected, I have been unable to receive any emails on the affected account since the issue began.
